description: Future-wiring + infra + docs: the THIN aws provider bundle (compiles, wired to the AWS SDK, selected by AIDLC_PROVIDER=aws), extensions to the existing iac/template.yaml (add the missing GET endpoints + Lambdas and fix the broken event chain, without rewriting), and the project README. Depends on FEAT-001/002/003 (needs the interfaces, the selector's dynamic-import contract, and the finished local surface to document). Mirrors plan.md items 8,9,10.
steps: Add AWS SDK deps to c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\package.json dependencies: @aws-sdk/client-s3, @aws-sdk/client-dynamodb, @aws-sdk/client-textract, @aws-sdk/client-comprehend, @aws-sdk/client-bedrock-runtime, @opensearch-project/opensearch. Run `bun install`.

Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\src\providers\aws\ implementations, one per interface (aws-storage.ts S3, aws-trace-store.ts DynamoDB agilia-traceability/agilia-findings, aws-search-index.ts OpenSearch, aws-document-extractor.ts Textract, aws-nlp-analyzer.ts Comprehend es, aws-rule-validator.ts Bedrock us.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5, aws-draft-generator.ts Bedrock). Each constructs its SDK client from config/env (region, bucket, table names — never hardcode secrets), implements the interface signature, and calls the service. Mapping of responses may be minimal but every method must typecheck and handle SDK errors. Mark incomplete mapping with `// FUTURE WIRING` comments, not silent no-ops.

Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\src\providers\aws\index.ts exporting a ProviderBundle assembled from the aws impls, matching what src/providers/index.ts dynamically imports when AIDLC_PROVIDER=aws.

Extend c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\iac\template.yaml (DO NOT rewrite existing resources): add DraftRetrieverFunction (python3.13, reads S3 draft + DynamoDB versions) and SearchHandlerFunction (python3.13, queries OpenSearch); add API Gateway resources/methods GET /documents/{documentId} and GET /documents/{documentId}/draft (new 'draft' resource under DocumentIdResource) and a new 'search' resource with GET /search, all AuthorizationType COGNITO_USER_POOLS using the existing ApiGatewayAuthorizer; add the matching AWS::Lambda::Permission (apigateway principal) for each new function; add the new methods to ApiGatewayDeployment.DependsOn. Keep SSE/KMS encryption, least-privilege IAM (reuse LambdaExecutionRole or scope tighter), no PII in logs.

Fix the broken EventBridge chain in iac/template.yaml: TextractProcessorFunction emits DetailType 'ExtractionStarted' but TextExtractedRule matches 'TextExtracted'. Align them (and document the choice in a YAML comment) so the documented data-flow actually connects. Do not remove unrelated resources.

Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\README.md: 1-paragraph what-AgilIA-is; the local-vs-aws provider model and how AIDLC_PROVIDER selects it; install/build/test (`bun install`, `bunx tsc --noEmit`, `bun test`); how to run the local demo (`bun run dev`, open web/index.html against http://localhost:8787) and the seeded sample flow (`bun run seed`); the IaC extension summary + how to lint it; and KNOWN MVP GAPS — no local auth (Cognito is the prod boundary), thin aws provider (compiles, not fully mapped), DOCX export deferred (editable Markdown used), and R13/R15/R16/R17 operational/deferred with the R1-R12 coverage table.
acceptance_criteria: `bun install` succeeds and `bunx tsc --noEmit` is clean across the WHOLE project including src/providers/aws.
The aws bundle implements all 7 interfaces and is the module src/providers/index.ts imports when AIDLC_PROVIDER=aws; the local runtime still never loads it.

iac/template.yaml parses as valid YAML, contains the new GET /documents/{id}, GET /documents/{id}/draft and GET /search methods plus DraftRetrieverFunction and SearchHandlerFunction and their API permissions, and the Textract event DetailType now matches its rule — with no existing resource removed or rewritten.
README lets a fresh reader install, build, test, and run the demo using only its instructions, and clearly lists the MVP gaps and R-coverage.
verification: bun -e "import('fs').then(async fs=>{const YAML=await import('yaml').catch(()=>null); const t=fs.readFileSync('iac/template.yaml','utf8'); if(YAML) YAML.parse(t); const need=['DraftRetrieverFunction','SearchHandlerFunction','search']; for(const n of need) if(!t.includes(n)) throw new Error('missing '+n); console.log('iac ok');})"
findings:
DELIVERED (bun 1.4.4). Final verification all green: `bun install` exit 0; `bunx tsc --noEmit` exit 0 (whole project incl. src/providers/aws); `bun test` => 44 pass / 0 fail / 130 expect() across 5 files; iac YAML/resource check => 'iac ok'. Also structurally validated the template with the `yaml` parser in a throwaway temp project (81 resources, 0 parse errors) and confirmed the aws bundle resolves via the selector (AIDLC_PROVIDER=aws + AWS_S3_BUCKET/AWS_OPENSEARCH_ENDPOINT set => all 7 keys present). Runtime .data/ removed after verification; no git run (git absent).

DEPS ADDED to package.json dependencies (resolved by bun to 3.1159.0 / 3.9.0): @aws-sdk/client-s3 ^3.700.0, @aws-sdk/client-dynamodb ^3.700.0, @aws-sdk/client-textract ^3.700.0, @aws-sdk/client-comprehend ^3.700.0, @aws-sdk/client-bedrock-runtime ^3.700.0, @opensearch-project/opensearch ^3.0.0. 44 packages installed.

THIN AWS BUNDLE (src/providers/aws/, import with .ts extensions per repo convention):
- aws-common.ts: shared helpers — AwsConfigError, AwsProviderError, callService(op, fn) (wraps SDK throws, no silent failure), requireConfig(value, what), AwsSettings + resolveAwsSettings(config, env). Table names fall back to CFN defaults (agilia-traceability-dev / agilia-findings-dev); Bedrock model ids + comprehend language come from env with defaults (ruleModelId/draftModelId default us.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5, language 'es').
- aws-storage.ts (class AwsStorage, S3): put (SSE AES256), get (returns null on NoSuchKey/404 via isNotFound, Body.transformToString()), list (paginated ListObjectsV2). Requires aws.bucket.
- aws-trace-store.ts (class AwsTraceStore, DynamoDB low-level client): single-table design PK=DOC#<id>, SK METADATA/VERSION#<padded>/DECISION#<id>; stores domain object as JSON under `data` attr; projects findings into the findings table on saveDocument. addVersion computes next version via listVersions. Per-attribute projection marked // FUTURE WIRING.
- aws-search-index.ts (class AwsSearchIndex, @opensearch-project/opensearch Client): index() writes one doc per finding to 'agilia-findings' (refresh:true); search() multi_match over message+evidence -> SearchResult[] (snippet = evidence.slice(0,200)). Requires aws.openSearchEndpoint. SigV4 signing marked // FUTURE WIRING.
- aws-document-extractor.ts (class AwsDocumentExtractor, Textract): extract() uses input.text if present else AnalyzeDocument on base64 bytes (FORMS/TABLES), joins LINE blocks. Returns ExtractedData {items:[], objeto=raw text evidence}; Textract-blocks->structured-fields mapping marked // FUTURE WIRING (never discards the text).
- aws-nlp-analyzer.ts (class AwsNlpAnalyzer, Comprehend): DetectEntities + DetectKeyPhrases, LanguageCode typed (cast from config, default 'es'), text truncated to 5000 UTF-8 bytes. Fully mapped to NlpResult.
- aws-rule-validator.ts (class AwsRuleValidator, Bedrock Claude): InvokeModel with a findings prompt; decodes Claude content; best-effort parse of a JSON findings array, accepting only entries with valid severity+category, HIGH => riskAlert. Does NOT return [] without invoking the model. Rich normalisation marked // FUTURE WIRING.
- aws-draft-generator.ts (class AwsDraftGenerator, Bedrock Claude): InvokeModel with a draft prompt; returns DraftDocument with the generated Markdown as content + a single 'borrador' section (documentId='' , version=1 — pipeline overrides, same contract as local). Structured FTN/FTP/Carta parsing marked // FUTURE WIRING.
- index.ts: `export function buildAwsProviders(config: AppConfig): ProviderBundle` — exactly what src/providers/index.ts dynamically imports for AIDLC_PROVIDER=aws. Clients constructed eagerly so missing required config throws AwsConfigError immediately. Local path never imports this module (non-literal specifier in the selector).

IAC (iac/template.yaml, EXTENDED — no existing resource removed/rewritten; verified 81 resources parse clean):
- Event-chain fix: TextExtractedRule detail-type 'TextExtracted' -> 'ExtractionStarted' to match what TextractProcessorFunction emits (documented in an inline YAML comment). Reconnects Textract -> Comprehend.
- New DraftRetrieverFunction (python3.13, reuses LambdaExecutionRole which already grants s3:GetObject + dynamodb:Query): reads S3 draft + DynamoDB DRAFT# versions; branches on event.resource ('/draft' returns content, else metadata+version list); safe status codes, no PII logged.
- New SearchHandlerFunction (python3.13, in-VPC via LambdaSecurityGroup + PrivateSubnet1/2) + dedicated least-privilege SearchHandlerRole (es:ESHttpGet/ESHttpPost scoped to the domain ARN + VPC access managed policy + X-Ray). Queries OpenSearch multi_match; SigV4 signing noted as prod wiring.
- API Gateway: DocumentGetMethod (GET /documents/{documentId} -> DraftRetriever), DraftResource ('draft' under DocumentIdResource) + DraftGetMethod (GET -> DraftRetriever), SearchResource ('search' under root) + SearchGetMethod (GET -> SearchHandler). All AuthorizationType COGNITO_USER_POOLS using the existing ApiGatewayAuthorizer.
- New AWS::Lambda::Permission: DraftRetrieverApiPermission + SearchHandlerApiPermission (principal apigateway.amazonaws.com).
- ApiGatewayDeployment.DependsOn now also lists DocumentGetMethod, DraftGetMethod, SearchGetMethod.
- Kept SSE/KMS encryption, least-privilege IAM, no PII in logs.

README.md created at root: what AgilIA is (1 para), local-vs-aws provider model + AIDLC_PROVIDER selection + dynamic-import note, install/build/test (bun install / bunx tsc --noEmit / bun test), run demo (bun run dev -> http://localhost:8787) with no-auth warning, seeded flow (bun run seed), HTTP API table, IaC extension summary + how to lint (aws cloudformation validate-template / cfn-lint), and KNOWN MVP GAPS (no local auth=Cognito prod boundary, thin aws provider, DOCX deferred, R13/R15/R16/R17 deferred) + an R1-R12 coverage table + project layout.

NOTES FOR LATER: config.ts (FEAT-001) has aws.{region,bucket,documentsTable,decisionsTable,versionsTable,openSearchEndpoint}; the aws bundle maps documentsTable->traceability table and reads the findings table + Bedrock model ids from env (AWS_DYNAMODB_FINDINGS_TABLE, AWS_BEDROCK_RULE_MODEL_ID, AWS_BEDROCK_DRAFT_MODEL_ID, AWS_COMPREHEND_LANGUAGE) with sensible defaults — config.ts was not modified. tsc needed `LanguageCode` import in aws-nlp-analyzer.ts (Comprehend's language param is a typed union, not string).
